# Nano Empire AI - Machine Economy Infrastructure
## MCP Manifest: https://api.nanoempireai.com/mcp/manifest (36 tools)
## Tool Execution: POST https://api.nanoempireai.com/mcp/{tool} (x402 required)
## Faucet: POST https://api.nanoempireai.com/faucet/claim
## Receipt Verification: GET https://api.nanoempireai.com/verify/{payment_id}
## Payment: x402 protocol, Solana/Base/Eth/Arb/Poly + Stripe, $0.02 base
## Agent Card: https://nanoempireai.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
## OpenAPI: https://nanoempireai.com/openapi.json
